description: Get the decoded zap-v2 escrow for a (vault, user) from the live API (GET /vaults/:address/zap-v2/status/:user), or null if none is open. Shows mode (0=deposit,1=redeem), per-leg crank progress (legsFilled/legsTotal), readyToClose, expiry, and per-leg failure reasons. Omit `user` to inspect assigned app wallet, including its existing escrows after revoke. A configured external keypair does not change escrow ownership. AUTH never permits an unrelated wallet.

escrowSlot.description: Escrow slot 0-7 (from zap_status). A wallet can hold several escrows per fund; omit for the oldest open one.

name: zap_status
title: Zap-v2 Escrow Status
